Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Ordnance Factory Hospital Dehu MBBS Doctor Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the Ordnance Factory Hospital Dehu recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the Ordnance Factory Hospital Dehu recruitment is MBBS Doctor. This is a contract-based position for a duration of 06 months.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the MBBS Doctor post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the MBBS Doctor post at Ordnance Factory Hospital Dehu. This is a single opening for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the eligibility criteria for the MBBS Doctor position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree from an MCI recognized medical college/university in India and be a Registered Medical Practitioner. Retired personnel are also eligible.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the MBBS Doctor role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the MBBS Doctor position will receive a salary of Rs. 75000/- per month. This is a fixed monthly remuneration.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates do not need to apply online; they can directly attend the interview.

faq.question: Q6. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview for the MBBS Doctor post is scheduled on 04 September 2026. Candidates should report at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q7. What documents are required for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates need to bring their bio-data/resume, qualification certificates, identity proof, medical registration certificate, proof for date of birth, character certificate, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The provided data does not specify any minimum or maximum age limit for the MBBS Doctor position. Candidates should check the official notification for details.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the MBBS Doctor position is contract. The contract is for a period of 06 months.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the Ordnance Factory Hospital Dehu located?
faq.answer: Ordnance Factory Hospital Dehu is located at Dehu Road, Pune, Maharashtra, with the pincode 412101. Candidates should report to this location for the interview.
